description: Rows where SBI's own published PDF breaks an expected relationship. Each has been checked against the source document: the number in the PDF really is what we extracted. verify.py excludes these so that a genuinely new violation is visible, and reports them separately. Do not 'correct' the data - add an entry here after confirming against the PDF.

buy_gt_sell.note: PDF prints travel-card sell as 22.99 while every neighbouring cell is ~24.8. Column positions confirmed correct against the USD row: the cell centres line up exactly, so this is SBI's typo, not a misparse.
